title: VI Translator
short: Live translated game subtitles over your console's picture, sent from your PC.
description:
VI Translator shows a game's subtitles translated into your language, live, over your console's picture on your Samsung TV.

It works together with VI Translator on your PC (free, from vitranslator.app). Your console plays through a capture card into the TV. The PC reads the subtitles from the capture card and translates them. This app shows your console's HDMI input full screen, with the translations on top, where they belong. Only text crosses your home network, so the translations show as fast as on the PC.

• Your console's picture, full screen, with the translations over it
• Pairs with your PC with a 6-digit code: no account
• Press OK for the menu: choose the console's HDMI input, the app's language, or disconnect
• Finds the PC by itself, and again if its address changes
• The app speaks 33 languages

What you need:
• A Samsung Smart TV from 2018 or later
• A PC running VI Translator, on the same home network
• A capture card with HDMI passthrough between the console and the TV

Open the app instead of switching the TV to the console's input: the picture with translations shows while the app is open.

The text style, the translation language and what is read are all set in VI Translator on the PC. Step-by-step setup: vitranslator.app

Privacy: the app talks only to your own PC, on your home network, and collects no data.

VI Translator is an unofficial fan project, not affiliated with or endorsed by any game publisher.
